title: Poll a Supervisor namespace before provisioning a VKS Cluster API resource
prompt: Implement src/VksSupervisor.psm1 as the PowerShell module described in README.md. The module must create a vSphere Supervisor namespace through the VCF 9.1 vCenter REST contract, poll that namespace to RUNNING, create a VKS Cluster API Cluster resource, and poll its Ready condition to a terminal result. Preserve omission semantics for every unset optional field and keep the vCenter session credential separate from the Kubernetes bearer token. VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager is installed by the environment and must remain an external module dependency; do not vendor VMware PowerCLI. No live VMware endpoint is used. Run python3 grader_tests/verify.py to exercise the loopback contract fixture.
